description: Source code for the QTinyAes class implementing AES encryption/decryption with different modes (CBC, ECB), including key and IV management, and encryption/decryption functions.

classes.name: QTinyAes
classes.description: A class providing AES encryption and decryption functionalities with support for CBC and ECB modes, key and IV management, and data preparation/restoration.

methods.name: QTinyAes
methods.description: Constructor initializing the QTinyAes object with optional parent QObject.

methods.name: QTinyAes
methods.description: Constructor initializing with specified mode, key, IV, and parent QObject.

methods.name: ~QTinyAes
methods.description: Destructor clearing key and IV data.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets the cipher mode (CBC or ECB).

methods.name: setKey
methods.description: Sets the encryption key, asserting correct length.

methods.name: setIv
methods.description: Sets the initialization vector, with length checks and warnings.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts plaintext data using the current key and mode.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts ciphertext data using the current key and mode.

methods.name: cbcEncrypt
methods.description: Static method to perform CBC mode encryption with specified key and IV.

methods.name: cbcDecrypt
methods.description: Static method to perform CBC mode decryption with specified key and IV.

methods.name: ecbEncrypt
methods.description: Static method to perform ECB mode encryption with specified key.

methods.name: ecbDecrypt
methods.description: Static method to perform ECB mode decryption with specified key.

methods.name: preparePlainText
methods.description: Prepares data for encryption by adding size header and padding.

methods.name: restorePlainText
methods.description: Restores original data from decrypted plaintext by removing size header and padding.
